text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after achieving the Triple Crown. 
A massive mountain of cardboard boxes was 
piled high in the Trainer's office!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A celebratory gift from Seiun Sky's 
grandfather. Standing out among the rest 
was an actual sea bream, a play on the 
word "medetai" (auspicious).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the Trainer stepped away— Seiun Sky 
happily acted pampered with her 
grandfather over a thank-you phone call.
